questions.question: A child inflates a balloon, increasing its size by 50%. Later, while tying it, the balloon’s size decreases by 20%. What is the overall percentage change in the size of the balloon?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase = 50%

Decrease = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Net change = (1 + a/100) × (1 − b/100)

Percentage change = (Final − Initial) ÷ Initial × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Assume initial size = 100

⇒ After 50% increase = 100 × 150/100 = 150

⇒ After 20% decrease = 150 × 80/100

⇒ = 120

⇒ Change = 120 − 100 = 20

⇒ Percentage change = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20% increase.**

questions.question: The diameter of a hemispherical bowl is 11.2 cm. How many litres of liquid can it hold ? (Use pi = (22)/(7) and round off your answer to three decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = 11.2 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 × π × r³

1 litre = 1000 cm³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Radius r = 11.2 ÷ 2 = 5.6

⇒ Volume = 2/3 × 22/7 × (5.6)³

⇒ (5.6)³ = 175.616

⇒ Volume = 2/3 × 22/7 × 175.616

⇒ = 2/3 × 551.936

⇒ = 1103.872 ÷ 3

⇒ = 367.957 cm³

⇒ In litres = 367.957 ÷ 1000

⇒ = 0.368

**∴ The correct answer is 0.368 litres.**

questions.question: The marks of P are 10 more than the marks of Q. The marks of Q are 10 more than half of the marks of P. The marks of Q are ____.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P = Q + 10

Q = (P ÷ 2) + 10

**Formula Used:**

Substitution method

**Calculation:**

⇒ P = Q + 10

⇒ Q = (P ÷ 2) + 10

⇒ Q = (Q + 10) ÷ 2 + 10

⇒ 2Q = Q + 10 + 20

⇒ 2Q = Q + 30

⇒ Q = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

questions.question: In a triangle with sides 12 units, 5 units and 13 units, the perpendiculars are drawn from all vertices. The length of the smallest perpendicular (in units) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides = 5, 12, 13

**Formula Used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Height = (2 × Area) ÷ base

**Calculation:**

⇒ Triangle is right-angled

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30

⇒ Height on side 13 = 2 × 30 ÷ 13 = 60/13

⇒ Height on side 12 = 2 × 30 ÷ 12 = 5

⇒ Height on side 5 = 2 × 30 ÷ 5 = 12

⇒ Smallest perpendicular = 60/13

**∴ The correct answer is 60/13.**

questions.question: In 330 litres solution of acid and water, the ratio of acid and water is 1:2. How many litres of acid must be added to it to get the solution in which the ratio of acid and water is 8:5?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total solution = 330 litres

Initial ratio (acid : water) = 1 : 2

Final ratio (acid : water) = 8 : 5

**Formula Used:**

Quantity = Total × Ratio ÷ Sum of ratios

New ratio = (Old acid + x) : Water

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial acid = 330 × 1 ÷ 3 = 110

⇒ Initial water = 330 × 2 ÷ 3 = 220

⇒ Let acid added = x

⇒ New acid = 110 + x

⇒ Ratio = (110 + x) : 220 = 8 : 5

⇒ (110 + x) ÷ 220 = 8 ÷ 5

⇒ 110 + x = 220 × 8 ÷ 5

⇒ = 220 × 8 ÷ 5 = 352

⇒ x = 352 − 110

⇒ x = 242

**∴ The correct answer is 242 litres.**

questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of Shreya and her mother is 3 : 5 and the ratio of present ages of her mother and her grandmother is 10 : 13. If the average age of Shreya, her mother and her grandmother is 58 years, then find the present age of her mother.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Shreya : Mother = 3 : 5

Mother : Grandmother = 10 : 13

Average age = 58

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of ages) ÷ 3

**Calculation:**

⇒ Shreya : Mother = 3 : 5

⇒ Mother : Grandmother = 10 : 13

⇒ Make mother common: LCM of 5 and 10 = 10

⇒ Shreya : Mother = 6 : 10

⇒ Mother : Grandmother = 10 : 13

⇒ Shreya : Mother : Grandmother = 6 : 10 : 13

⇒ Total ratio = 6 + 10 + 13 = 29

⇒ Sum of ages = 58 × 3 = 174

⇒ 1 part = 174 ÷ 29 = 6

⇒ Mother’s age = 10 × 6

⇒ Mother’s age = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

questions.question:
Pipe P can fill (4)/(5) part of a tank in 28 hours and pipe Q can fill (2)/(3) part of the same tank in 42 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 7 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 14 hours.

Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for P = 28 × 5/4 = 35 hours; Time for Q = 42 × 3/2 = 63 hours.

LCM(35, 63) = 315 units (Total Work).

Efficiency: P = 9, Q = 5.

Filled in 7 hours = (9 + 5) × 7 = 98 units.

R efficiency = 98 ÷ 14 = 7 units/hr (emptying).

Net efficiency (P+Q−R) = 9 + 5 − 7 = 7 units/hr.

Required time = 315 ÷ 7 = 45 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 45 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given: **

P fills 4/5 in 28 hrs, Q fills 2/3 in 42 hrs, R empties filled part in 14 hrs after 7 hrs.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time;

Efficiency of filling pipe is positive, emptying is negative.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Full time for P = 28 × (5 ÷ 4) = 35 hours

⇒ Full time for Q = 42 × (3 ÷ 2) = 63 hours

⇒ Let Total Work = LCM(35, 63) = 315 units

⇒ Work done by P and Q in 7 hours = 7 × (Efficiency of P + Efficiency of Q)

⇒ Work done = 7 × (9 + 5) = 98 units

⇒ Efficiency of R = Work ÷ Time = 98 ÷ 14 = 7 units/hr (negative work)

⇒ Time for R to empty full tank = 315 ÷ 7 = 45 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 45 hours.**

Pipes and Cisterns Basics

Inlet pipes add to the volume (positive efficiency), while outlet pipes or leaks subtract from the volume (negative efficiency).

Net Work Done

If pipe A fills in x hours and pipe B empties in y hours (where y > x), net work in 1 hour = (1/x − 1/y). Time to fill = (x × y) ÷ (y − x).

Combined Efficiency

When multiple pipes operate, total efficiency is the algebraic sum of their individual efficiencies: Eₜₒₜₐₗ = E₁ + E₂ − Eₗₑₐₖ.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7. Find the sum of the numbers, if their HCF is 23.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio = 5 : 7

HCF = 23

**Formula Used:**

Sum of numbers = HCF × (Sum of ratio terms)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of ratio terms = 5 + 7

⇒ Sum of ratio terms = 12

⇒ Sum of numbers = 23 × 12

⇒ Sum of numbers = 276

**∴ The correct answer is 276.**

questions.question: If third proportional of 9 and 60 be x, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First number = 9

Second number = 60

Third proportional = x

**Formula Used:**

Third proportional: a : b = b : x

x = b² ÷ a

**Calculation:**

⇒ x = 60² ÷ 9

⇒ x = 3600 ÷ 9

⇒ x = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,500 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:

Rate = 10%

Time = 2 years

Amount = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount = 2500 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount = 2500 × (110/100)²

⇒ Amount = 2500 × (11/10)²

⇒ Amount = 2500 × 121/100

⇒ Amount = 25 × 121

⇒ Amount = 3025

**∴ The correct answer is 3025.**

questions.question: Two trains, 133 m and 227 m long, are moving in the same direction at speeds of 93 km/hr and 51 km/hr, respectively. How much time will the faster train take to completely cross the slower one?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of first train = 133 m

Length of second train = 227 m

Speed of first train = 93 km/hr

Speed of second train = 51 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (same direction) = difference of speeds

Time = total distance ÷ relative speed

Speed conversion: km/hr × 5/18 = m/s

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 93 - 51 = 42 km/hr

⇒ Relative speed = 42 × 5/18 = 35/3 m/s

⇒ Total distance = 133 + 227 = 360 m

⇒ Time = 360 ÷ (35/3)

⇒ Time = 360 × 3/35

⇒ Time = 1080/35

⇒ Time = 216/7

⇒ Time = 30 (6)/(7) seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 30 (6)/(7) seconds.**

questions.question: A shop that sells towels has offers going on, wherein customers can buy 2 towels and get 3 free. What is the percentage discount that the customer gets?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Buy 2 towels, get 3 towels free

Total towels received = 5

**Formula Used:**

Discount % = (Free items ÷ Total items) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Free towels = 3

⇒ Total towels = 5

⇒ Discount % = (3 ÷ 5) × 100

⇒ Discount % = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60%.**

questions.question: A trader sells a watch at a loss of 28%. If he had sold it for ₹280 more, he would have made neither a profit nor a loss. What is the cost price of the watch?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss = 28%

Increase in selling price = 280

**Formula Used:**

Selling price at loss = CP × (1 - loss/100)

No profit no loss: SP = CP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = x

⇒ SP at 28% loss = x × (72/100)

⇒ New SP = x × (72/100) + 280

⇒ x × (72/100) + 280 = x

⇒ x - x × (72/100) = 280

⇒ x × (28/100) = 280

⇒ x = 280 × 100 ÷ 28

⇒ x = 1000

**∴ The correct answer is 1000.**

questions.question: A person saves 60% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹520, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure = ₹520

Savings = 60% of income

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure ÷ (1 - Savings %)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Income = ₹520 ÷ (1 - 60%)

⇒ Income = ₹520 ÷ (1 - 0.6)

⇒ Income = ₹520 ÷ 0.4

⇒ Income = ₹1300

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1300.**
